items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 21 at 6:22AM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
A storm system will sweep through the coastal waters Wednesday
morning through early Thursday resulting in hazardous weather for
the Central Coast waters. Peak threat for thunderstorms will be
early Wednesday morning through Wednesday afternoon. Developed
storms will be capable of producing local gale force wind gusts,
rough seas, lightning, heavy rainfall with reduced visibility, and
waterspouts.
